mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ores.result_qty), 0) FROM outbound_results AS ores WHERE ores.outbound_schedule_id = #{outboundScheduleId} AND ores.company_id = #{companyId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound_results( company_id, outbound_schedule_id, result_qty, result_date ) VALUES( #{companyId}, #{outboundScheduleId}, #{resultQty}, #{resultDate} )
